pokedexEntries.rb: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

pokedexEntries.ye: It may be mistaken for a clump of weeds. If you try to yank it out of the ground, it shrieks horribly.

pokedexEntries.go: Awakened by moonlight, it roams actively at night. In the day, it stays quietly underground.

pokedexEntries.si: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

pokedexEntries.cr: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

pokedexEntries.ru: During the daytime, ODDISH buries itself in soil to absorb nutrients from the ground using its entire body. The more fertile the soil, the glossier its leaves become.

pokedexEntries.sa: ODDISH searches for fertile, nutrient-rich soil, then plants itself. During the daytime, while it is planted, this POKéMON’s feet are thought to change shape and become similar to the roots of trees.

pokedexEntries.fr: Its scientific name is “Oddium Wanderus.” At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000 feet on its two roots.

pokedexEntries.lg: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

pokedexEntries.em: This POKéMON grows by absorbing moonlight. During the daytime, it buries itself in the ground, leaving only its leaves exposed to avoid detection by its enemies.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.
